faq.q: How does the free trial work?
faq.a: Anyone can try the Hex Team plan free for 14 days, no payment card required. At the end of your trial you can choose to continue on a paid plan. If you do nothing, you'll be downgraded to the free Community plan and lose access to premium features.

faq.q: How do I cancel or change my plan?
faq.a: Professional and Team customers can cancel or change their plan anytime from Settings > Manage Plan. If you cancel, you will still have access to your paid plan until the end of your billing period. If you upgrade or downgrade, the change will apply right away and you’ll be charged or credited for the remainder of your billing cycle.  Enterprise customers can manage renewals and cancellations with their account representative.

faq.q: How do you handle security and compliance?
faq.a: We are audited annually for SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance and are dedicated to safeguarding your data. Learn more here.

AI features in Hex consume credits based on the effort required to complete the task. All paid plans include a credit grant, with the option to purchase add-on credits.Professional and Team plans include monthly per-seat credit grants that are assigned to each paid user, refresh monthly and don't roll over. Enterprise plan credit grants are custom as specified on your order form.See our docs article for more info.

faq.q: Do you have a discount for students and educators?
faq.a: Yes! Students and educators at universities and bootcamps can access the Hex Professional Plan for free. Contact support@hex.tech for details.

faq.q: Do you have a discount for non-profits?
faq.a: Yes - we have a discounted program for qualified non-profits - write to support@hex.tech to see if you qualify.
